normalized_cause: Do not classify every 10:00 shift as 24H
evidence_summary: Any shift starting at 10:00 now satisfies the 24H predicate regardless of its end time. In particular, `ShiftWindow(10, 22)` is checked before `is_10_22h_shift` and is therefore returned as `covered_by_24h`, contradicting the independent 10–22H bucket and causing its coverage to be overcounted as a full-day shift.
